sections.title: Burt's characterisation
sections.line: Burt, chapter on Sagittarius (pdf pp. 339–378): pdf p339 and p342.

quotes.quote: Traditionally astrologers have associated Sagittarius with Spirit, expansion of awareness, aspiring to greatness, and the ability to motivate, inspire, or “fire up” others.
Now, in Sagittarius, we bask once more in the sunlight of a solar Fire sign and again experience conscious, extroverted energy.
It is both mental and active, just as Sagittarius is Mutable and fiery.
Zeus, or Jupiter, as the Romans called him, the ruler of Sagittarius.

sections.title: Burt's myths and shadow
sections.line: Burt, chapter on Sagittarius (pdf pp. 339–378): pdf p345, p346 and p361.

quotes.quote: The story of Hercules and his beloved friend and teacher adds another dimension to our understanding of Sagittarius—the generosity of the Sage.
Chiron, the Immortal, could not stop his own wound from aching
Though Mutable, Sagittarius is a Fire sign and does have a temper.

sections.title: What Jung says
sections.line: Jung on the archer and the centaur: Dream Analysis seminar, pdf p435.

quotes.quote: The archer Sagittarius with the arrow of intuition foresees new birth out of the unconscious.
Then comes the legend of the centaur, a good archer, who with his bow can send an arrow across.
